name: Healthgrades
description: Healthgrades is a consumer healthcare directory for finding doctors and hospitals, comparing qualifications and patient reviews, and connecting with appointment options. Healthcare professionals can claim verified profiles to maintain practice information and respond to reviews, while health systems and approved partners use broader listings, reputation and patient-access products.
agentUseSummary: Healthgrades cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because ordinary profile management is an identity-verified professional portal, while its advertised listings and Patient Experience Survey APIs are available through an approved partner network without a public current authentication and endpoint contract. Relay will not scrape the directory or collect professional login, license-verification or phone-verification material.

blocked.label: Connect a Healthgrades professional profile
blocked.description: Relay does not collect provider portal passwords, license or DEA fragments, verification codes, phone authority, cookies, representative attestations or practice administrator sessions.

blocked.label: Extract Healthgrades directory data
blocked.description: Relay does not scrape, crawl, reverse engineer, mirror or republish provider profiles, ratings, reviews, hospital data, availability, proprietary methodologies or Site Materials.

blocked.label: Manage profiles and patient reviews
blocked.description: Relay does not edit provider or practice listings, upload professional content, solicit or respond to patient reviews, manage reputation or syndicate changes without an approved partner API and verified owner authority.

blocked.label: Manage appointments or health data
blocked.description: Relay does not search or book care for a patient, exchange intake or appointment data, process protected or consumer health information, or automate scheduling through the public site.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No action is exposed until Healthgrades accepts Relay into the relevant partner network and supplies an approved, current, bounded API and healthcare data contract.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts no Healthgrades portal login, verification material, directory scraper, partner credential, profile mutation, review response, appointment action or health data in OpenClaw.
Relay mounts no Healthgrades portal login, verification material, directory scraper, partner credential, profile mutation, review response, appointment action or health data in Hermes.

providerSetup.blocker: Healthgrades' public provider experience is a professional portal, not a developer API. Claiming a profile requires the physician or an authorized representative to establish identity, provide license or DEA verification material, receive a phone verification code, attest authorization and accept a binding Physician User Agreement. The agreement restricts portal and Site Material extraction, transmission, mirroring and reverse engineering. Healthgrades separately advertises a listings and reputation partner network that can update provider data and integrate its Patient Experience Survey API, but entry is application-based and the public page does not publish current endpoints, authentication, scopes, schemas, environment, credential lifecycle, limits or data-use terms. Appointment scheduling may involve PHI, consumer health data and a separate patient authorization. Selecting a partner product, executing its agreement and establishing healthcare data roles are external business and legal commitments; an ordinary provider portal account or public profile cannot be repurposed as Railway authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request professional credentials, license or DEA information, verification codes, profile ownership attestations, portal cookies, patient accounts, review content, appointment data or health information; claim a profile; apply to the partner network; scrape the public site; automate the portal; accept agreements; or show Connect. An authorized Relay business owner must first select the listings/reputation, survey and/or patient-access product, obtain legal, privacy and healthcare approval, join Healthgrades' approved partner network, receive current official API documentation and sandbox credentials, and define permitted providers, data, syndication, retention and actions. Then implement only that contract with tenant and provider ownership, least privilege, credential rotation, review and PHI redaction, approvals, audit, revocation and Railway-staging acceptance.

evidence.supports: Healthgrades directs providers to claim and update profiles, manage reputation and resolve account access through its professional portal and help channels.
Healthgrades profile registration requires a medical professional or authorized representative, license or DEA verification material, phone verification and an authorization attestation.
Healthgrades advertises profile updates and a Patient Experience Survey API specifically through an approved listings and reputation partner network with an application to join.

Healthgrades requires verified physician or representative authority and a binding portal agreement and restricts transmission, download, mirroring, reverse engineering and use of portal materials absent written permission.
Healthgrades explains that directory and rating data combines NPI, provider, patient survey, claims, government and third-party sources and supports search, reviews and several appointment paths.
Healthgrades' appointment service documents collection and exchange of health history and appointment data, HIPAA business-associate context, separate patient authorization and revocation.
